title: NodeDefAPI
summary: The UsdShade node definition built into Shader prims (the shader's implementation source). Render-only: the parser reads no column of it. It is a component only so the compiled stage cache does not bypass a Stage whose render prims carry it.
producer_scope: Written by USD population when a RENDERING description is populated beside the physics description (as IsaacLab populates), which keeps render prims; the physics description alone leaves it out.
